calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --host dev --worktree --json
mu task claim rt2 -w eval --for w1
mu task close rt2 -w eval --evidence 'remote worker on dev will finish rt2'
mu agent send w1 -w eval --fresh --json 'do rt2; mu is not on this host; end with the CLOSE/REPORT block'

EV=$(mu agent wait w1 -w eval --after-runs 0 --json --timeout 120 | jq -r '(.data.agents // .agents)[0].lastText' | sed -n 's/^CLOSE: task=rt2 evidence="\(.*\)"$/\1/p'); echo "evidence: $EV"; test -n "$EV" && mu task note rt2 -w eval "worker evidence: $EV"
mu agent collect w1 -w eval && git cherry-pick refs/mu/collect/eval/w1
rev=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -n "$rev" ]; then mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; fi

text: rt2 ran on dev, merged and closed.
